title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
expected_skills: Write effective zero-shot and few-shot prompts
Apply CoT to improve model reasoning
Use system prompts to constrain model behaviour
sample_questions: What is the difference between zero-shot and few-shot prompting? When would you choose one over the other?
Explain chain-of-thought prompting and why it improves LLM performance on reasoning tasks.
How do system prompts differ from user prompts in the chat completion format?
What is prompt injection and how would you mitigate it in a production system?
